body:
Two items in [v5.0.be_cwe_mapping.json](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/260dbb0/5.0/mappings/v5.0.be_cwe_mapping.json) appear to have been removed in prior commits and need remapping:
```
143:    "v5.0.be-10.7.6": "412",
...
179:    "v5.0.be-14.1.7": "489",
```

[commit 8480e83d267ffc8b21861abac9ca864506440e08] **v5.0.be-14.1.7** was merged into **v5.0.be-14.1.9**, which still aligns with [CWE-489](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/489.html). **v5.0.be-14.1.9** is not currently referenced in the CWE mapping file, so changing the current reference to "**v5.0.be-14.1.7**" with "**v5.0.be-14.1.9**" should resolve the issue.

[commit 547f688214973b617c30ab4bd6f151745420c3ac] **v5.0.be-10.7.6** was merged into **v5.0.be-10.7.4**, which still aligns with [CWE-412](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/412.html). Unfortunately, **v5.0.be-10.7.4** is already mapped to [CWE-833](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/833.html) (also related to locking) so it's unclear if the old reference to **v5.0.be-10.7.6** should be updated or removed. As of now, there is only one CWE mapped to a given requirement ID. This appears to be by design, as the requirement ID is used as the JSON ID for each CWE. Given that restriction, we would either need to verify which of the two exploits best aligns with **v5.0.be-10.7.4** (CWE-412 or CWE-833), or split these two requirements out again.

comments.body: For feedback - @seth-mccauley - as it [is written in the document](https://asvs.dev/v5.0.0/For-Users-Of-4.0/#moving-away-from-common-weakness-enumeration-cwe), we dropped CWE mapping, and as we decided it quite some time ago, we did not keep focus on keeping the information up to date or did not validate precisely how correct those mappings are. All the mapping questions should be solved via OpenCRE developments.

title: Unused references in CWE mapping file
